full_judgment: 11. Every Muslim who has attained majority may enter into a contract of marriage. Majority is attained at puberty. The presumption is that a person attains majority at 15 years. The earliest period of puberty for a boy is 12 years and for a girl is 9 years. It appears from the Nikahnama that the plaintiff was 25 years old at the time of marriage but the claim of the plaintiff that he was only 13 years old at the time of the marriage, which he claims by virtue of a certificate given by the headmaster of a local school does not carry much weight. The suit was filed for declaration that the Nikahnama dated 18-5-91 in respect of marriage in between plaintiff and defendant in illegal, collusive and not binding upon the plaintiff and the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner put emphasis that the Nikahnama is the product of fraud as it was obtained by practicing fraud upon the plaintiff.
